entities.summary: Charles Augustus "Kid" Nichols was an American Major League Baseball (MLB) pitcher who played for the Boston Beaneaters, St. Louis Cardinals and Philadelphia Phillies from 1890 to 1906. A switch hitter who threw right-handed, he was listed at 5 feet 10 inches (1.78 m) and 175 pounds (79 kg). He is a member of the Baseball Hall of Fame. Kid Nichols was a athletes & competitors from Madison (1869-09-14, Madison–1953-04-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
